title: Cosmos DB (NoSQL)
description: Cosmos DB for NoSQL account with one database. Keys are disabled (Entra ID RBAC only), closed to the internet by default, TLS 1.2, continuous 7-day backup. Serverless or autoscale provisioned throughput.
security_defaults: Key-based (local) authentication disabled: Entra ID data-plane RBAC only
Public network access off; TLS 1.2 minimum

capacity_mode.description: Serverless (pay per request) or Provisioned (autoscale throughput on the database). Cannot be changed later.

max_throughput.description: Provisioned only: autoscale maximum RU/s (multiples of 1000).

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet (through the IP firewall). Leave false and use a private endpoint (subresource 'Sql').

allowed_ip_ranges.description: Public IPs / CIDR ranges allowed when public access is on.

notes: Data access uses Cosmos DB's own data-plane role assignments (for example 'Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor'); grant them separately.
